chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who catches the Imam when he is giving the taslim. He said:
He must give the adhan, establish the iqamah, and begin the salat (prayer).

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the salat (prayer) to be begun individually
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader in the congregational salat
key_terms.عَمَّارٌ: ʿAmmār, the narrator asking the Imam
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنَ: to give the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: gives the final taslim concluding the prayer
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to give the iqamah, the call commencing the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he reaches the Imam just as the congregational prayer is ending?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who arrives too late to join the congregational salat and finds the Imam at the moment of taslim. He should perform the adhan and iqamah and then begin his own salat.
